Results.ReviewText: We have always used a large grill and after so many problems with larger grills we decided that this Weber was just perfect for us, right size!  It cooks everything really fast, plus portable if you need it to be, we are not using it for that though.  Highly recommend!
Results.Title: Love our Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: The Weber® Q 1200 Gas Grill is a game-changer! Its compact design and powerful performance make grilling a breeze. The quick ignition system gets things going in no time, and the cast-iron cooking grates ensure even heat distribution for perfect results. I love the sleek design that adds style to my outdoor space, and the durable build quality speaks volumes about Weber's commitment to excellence. Whether for backyard barbecues or on-the-go grilling, the Q 1200 is a top-notch choice, earning a well-deserved five stars.
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200: Five-Star Grilling Excellence

Results.Title: Excellent grill for smaller spaces.

I would love to have the genesis but really can't afford it though. I have the stand for my Q which is great. I plan on getting the adapter hose because i have 2 --20lb propane cylinders from past grills

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had Weber q grill in the past but didn’t recall the difficulty in getting grill up to temperature. I did check that I hadnt Tripped the safety feature with the gas causing it to run in safe level. Just didn’t cook the way I wanted It to. I plan to return the grill

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. We are sorry to hear your experience did not match your expectations. We are happy to help. The Q1200 is not specific for an RV connection. However, we would suggest the Weber RV Traveler grill model 9011701 that has the proper connection for this. If you need anything further please reach out to us directly. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Overall I like the grill and stand combo. My strong objection is how you plumb your product. It comes with a gas regulator on the unit! My problem is all RV campers also have a gas regulator. So with 2 regulators you get hardly any gas flow to the grill. My solution was to remove the regulator supplied from Weber and use custom plumbing to make unit work! Seems like company could do better!!
Results.Title: Company should consider better gas supply

Results.ReviewText: We Rv a lot and this bbq is the perfect size , it hears up quickly and cooks great .
Results.Title: I like the size .

Results.ReviewText: I travel for work so I bought this grill to keep in my camper because of portability & recommendations from a couple friends that have a similar one. I enjoy cooking on it so much that when I’m home I bring it with me.
Results.Title: Camping/work grill that is light weight & portable

Results.ReviewText: Great grill and compact.  Perfect for traveling with and tailgating.
Results.Title: Perfect compact grill

Results.ReviewText: I originally bought a cheaper portable propane grill, but it never got hot enough, it would dry out my meat and not sear it. After a ton of wasted food and frustration, I finally decided to splurge and buy the Weber Q1200.  It heats up fast and gives my food a perfect sear.  It makes grilling so easy!  I was nervous about the Q1200 not being big enough for our family of 5, but it’s perfect and fits nicely in our camper. (I originally ordered the Q2000 but it was way too big to transport so I sent it back and got the Q1200).  My only complaint (and it’s hardly a complaint), is that on the right handle, the propane assembly and tank blocks your fingers from getting a proper grip on the handle which makes carrying the grill a little bit difficult.  But overall, I’m totally satisfied. I’ve had it for about two months and have used it weekly and every time we sit down to eat our perfectly grilled food, I tell my husband how much I love that grill and that I should’ve bought it sooner!
Results.Title: I love it!  I should have bought it sooner!

Photos.Caption: Harbor Freight Tool Cart Perfect Fit

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. Perfect for a couple. Works great. Excellent quality. It fits perfectly on the tool cart I bought.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber is known for quality and customer support. My grill retains the heat, easy to light, easy to clean, and has cast iron grates. I love it!
Results.Title: A Quality Grill

Results.ReviewText: Very nice little grill.  For one person is is perfect.  I do wish there was a little more control over the heat as tends to get too hot very quickly (for grilling fish).  But overall, still impressed.  I like the foldout side tables.  I have had no issues with them collapsing under load as a few stated.  Easy start and easy to clean.
Results.Title: Nice little grill

Results.ReviewText: You can't beat Webber and I love this particular camping/portable line & bought the 1200. Everything is stellqr except for the folding tables. They fold inwards against the cooking grate and get greasy, dirty, lame design. I took my last ones off and now carry a cut out piece of cardboard I place on the grilltop for travel or I'd have given it 5 stars. Last one lasted 10 yrs, fell off a table, exploded causing this 2nd purchase.
Results.Title: 2nd purchase & fantastic, but...

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. It is the perfect size for me and grills nicely. My family was here and they even commented on how nice it was and how it grills evenly. Love it!
Results.Title: Awesome Grill!

Results.ReviewText: I had never owned an outdoor BBQ until I saw the little weber. I had been intimidated because I had always thought they would be complicated to use and not worth the trouble. I was wrong. This weber was easy to assemble, easy to use, and adds delicious options to my menu.
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200

Results.ReviewText: I bought this Q 1200 Weber grill to replace my previous Q1200 Weber grill. I owned and used the previous 1200 Weber grill for mor than 20 years. Need I say more?
Results.Title: Replaced my previous 1200 Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Just what I wanted, even lighter than the Q2200that I at my house. This is for my travel trailer. I cook on my Webber about 200 times a year. I love them.
Results.Title: Perfect size and weight for an older gentleman

Results.ReviewText: A typical Weber grill; perfect! We got our first Weber (22 1/2" charcoal) in 1970 and used it til we moved across the country in 2004! We have a 2 burner gas grill, but this new one is so much easier to move around.  We got the "cart" with the Q1200 and while it is a little wobbly it serves the purpose well.
Results.Title: It's a Weber; perfect!

Results.ReviewText: I have always liked Weber grills.  We bought the smaller Weber q to keep in our 5th wheel, it is the perfect size.  I love the way it cooks!
Results.Title: Perfect

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill.  Susceptible to wind, does not heat quite super hot for a steak sizzle.  Meets our needs and purpose we bought it for...compact and lightweight..changed regulator to slave off camper
Results.Title: The little engine that can

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, love the cooking surface, easy  to clean. Cooks food evenly, great temperature control. Folds up into a small package for easy transport. Comes in various colors, has fold out trays on both sides of grill on the outside which are handy for holding cooking utensils or food to be cooked. I have had several small portable grills in the past, none even come close to this grill.
Results.Title: Little Big Grill

Results.ReviewText:
This is a replacement for a gas grill when we moved into a condo - 2 years ago. Even bought a second for our vacation condo. Worked as expected until the controller seems to have stopped working. And a replacement is out of stock. From the reviews, seems to be a common problem. To Weber, yes, it was stored in the garage between uses. When it works, it is perfect for how we use it. Hopefully the controller problem is addressed. Maybe it will be back in stock as a new and improved replacement part.

UPDATE - The controller was back in stock the day after I posted my review.  The replacement is on the way.
Results.Title: Perfect for condo, but...

Results.ReviewText: Got this grill when we purchased our RV.  Got the stand too. Well designed, easy to use and store, somebody really put a lot of thought into it. Holds a lot more food than I thought it would.  Love the different colors.
Results.Title: Easy to use, compact size, perfect for RVing

Results.ReviewText: Works good. use it in the camper when not at home.
Results.Title: Small but good

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill for tailgating or just making one or two burgers.

Results.ReviewText: Best lil grill out there! I’ve had several! Fixed over 30 meals in the last 3 weeks on this grill while traveling the Rockies on vacation! Now just want to save up for the griddle plate!
Results.Title: Best lil grill around!

Results.ReviewText: This is our fourth Weber grill that we have purchase in the last twenty-five years. All of them still work. The little travel grill we bought in the '90's has been great but it's time. This portable unit can be set on a picnic table without burning it. We're able to stop buying all those little one-use propane cans with the purchase of a 10-pound tank and a 6' conversion hose. The extension shelves are sturdy and fold back onto the unit well for travel. The grates are easy to brush clean.
Results.Title: Great portable unit.

Results.ReviewText: I am a life long Weber owner.  Genesis at home and Q1200 for our Motorhome.  Consistently excellent quality and performance.  I have tried others twice thinking I was getting a great deal - and I didn’t.   Fooled twice - never again.
Results.Title: Best Grills for home and on the road
